notes: All Chinese spot / benchmark quotes are VAT-inclusive (13%); every value here = quoted CNY/t ÷ 1.13 ÷ 1000. PEEK is derived from annual-report revenue, which is already ex-VAT.
Delivered-to-plant: SunSirs and East China market quotes are ex-warehouse East China (Yangtze Delta); no freight added. PRD/Chongqing/Wuhan typically within ±100–300 CNY/t for commodity resins.

Method limit: WebFetch and direct HTTP to the price sites were unavailable from this sandbox; all figures were read from search-engine extracts of the cited pages (titles such as 'X月X日生意社Y基准价为Z元/吨' are the agency's own daily notices). 35 web searches used.
Market context Sep–Oct 2026: olefins and styrenics are near 12-month highs (PP +7%, LLDPE +8% since 1 Sep, ABS +30% since July, PX +16% in Sep); PC and PBT were weak in mid-2026.

Book grades that are compounds or semi-finished stock (rubber 'xx Shore A' compounds, GF compounds, fabrics, prepregs, stock shapes, paints) are not directly comparable with the raw-polymer prices here.
Not found: PP copolymer K8003 figure, TPE/TPV, PPS (2026), PA6-GF30, PP-GF30/talc, FKM, raw silicone gum, compounded rubber, prepreg, SMC, powder-coat / e-coat levels.
